information: # Note: This is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Only competition. Welcome to Malaysia FMC Championship 2024! As FMC is not being held at [Malaysia 15th Anniversary Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2024), this is your chance to become the Malaysia's Fewest Moves Champion! The competition will be held in Kuala Lumpur & Johor Bahru. Please check select the [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2024#46491-location) you wish to join FMC when you make the payment. **3x3x3 Fewest Moves event** (**this may not be recommended for new competitor**). For those who are interested in joining **Please Be Quiet Kuala Lumpur 2024** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietKualaLumpur2024) / **Please Be Quiet Johor 2024** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietJohor2024). The event will take place at the same venue before this competition. [![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2024)
